scope: disposable loopback only; same-host generator, backend and database
percentiles: sorted[ceil(q*N)-1]; null for N=0; successful observations only, errors separately

chat.boundary: REST dispatch to recipient WS frame received; sender echo separate

generator.lag_rule: all dispatch lag <=100ms; no request drops; max in-flight=5000 aborts rather than silently throttles
generator.revision_reason: Before server measurements, calibrate at highest actual requested rate (150 diagnostic, 100 target). Both exploratory 300RPS failures are retained; 300 was surplus capacity, not a server requirement.

errors: Every scheduled attempt remains in raw data; HTTP errors, invalid JSON/content, transport errors, timeout and missing WS separate. No retry replacement.
resources: Four independently timestamped streams: resources (server/generator CPU/RSS and DB activity/locks), pool (local-attach Hikari active/idle/total/pending), heap (validated jstat numeric gauges), docker (owned-container cgroup v2 cpu.stat/memory.current/memory.stat/io.stat via fixed docker exec cat every 1s). All timestamps use generator monotonic clock; cgroup CPU%=100*delta(usage_usec)/delta(time_usec). Cgroup memory.current and anon are bytes; heap capacities/utilization are jstat KiB and GC times seconds.
coverage: For each measurement phase, all four streams must have >=2 samples, first and last edge gaps <=2s, all inter-sample gaps <=2s. Header text alone is not a heap sample. Capture errors or absent SQL evidence make evidence PARTIAL independently of metric PASS. A ten-second live telemetry preflight uses the same rule before workload warmup.
sql_statistics: Current database pg_stat_statements queryid/calls/rows snapshots before and after each phase; no SQL text or parameters. Deltas include background jobs and observer queries and are not exact SQL-per-REST attribution.
pool_limitation: Four instantaneous gauges are not a per-request pool-wait duration histogram. JMX must be explicitly enabled only in the local diagnostic server configuration.
